jobs.title: Brand Manager - ECOVER
jobs.description:
Lifestyle Brands (the LSB) is a growing house of like-minded brands under the SC Johnson umbrella including Method®, Mrs. Meyer’s Clean Day®,   Babyganics ® and   Ecover ®. Headquartered in San Francisco with additional operations in Chicago and throughout Europe, the LSB is home to 650 employees. Together we act as a force for bold, transformative growth with a focus on delivering positive impact for people and the planet. If you’re into pioneering the future and doing good while doing business, come join us.

The LSB is part of SC Johnson, a family-owned company and leading manufacturer of household cleaning, home storage, air care, pest control and shoe care products, as well as professional products. Originally founded in 1886 and headquartered in Wisconsin, U.S.A., SC Johnson and the Lifestyle Brands division are at work for a better world.

Brand Manager ECOVER
(Internal title: Senior Associate, Brand Marketing)

·       Location: Frimley, UK
·       Function: Marketing
·       Contract Type: Permanent
·       People Leader: Senior Brand Manager (Associate Manager)

Please note this role is not eligible for relocation.
Onsite position - remote work is available once per week for eligible employees.

What’s in it for you?
- Competitive pay & benefits
- Flexible working hours + compressed week hours (1/2 day off on Fridays)
- ‘Build your own’ learning programme
- Free breakfast & snacks
- 25 days annual holiday + additional days after service
- Pension, Life cover & Health Insurance & income protection
- Volunteering days
- Season ticket loan
- Wellness days

Overview:
At SC Johnson Lifestyle Brands, we're a fifth-generation family company built on a spirit of adventure, innovation, and doing what's right for people and the planet. As part of our Lifestyle Brands business (LSB), you'll have the opportunity to contribute to the growth of ECOVER, one of the UK's most recognised sustainability-focused household cleaning brands.

We're looking for a commercially minded and creative marketing professional to join our UK ECOVER team. This is an exciting opportunity to help shape brand strategy, create impactful consumer campaigns, lead social media engagement, and drive shopper conversion across multiple touchpoints in our largest and most strategic market.

About the role:
This Brand Manager (Senior Associate role) within the ECOVER brand team exists to ensure greater breadth of oversight of the ECOVER brand plans and brand performance. The UK is the largest and most strategic market for Ecover globally. This role will be responsible for supporting development, execution and implementation of brand plans in the market – with oversight of every consumer touchpoint (comms, PR, digital, shopper).

The role will lead the social media strategy and execution to drive brand consideration as well as lead the conversion strategy, asset development and asset deployment with customers.

This role will allow for breadth of experience and capability to allow for development within the LSB organization!
Responsibilities:
- Lead the development and delivery of the brand plan in the market
- Responsible for delivering conversion strategy / shopper (on/offline) for the brand in the market and developing conversion assets with support of the in-house studio from concept to execution
- This role will also lead social media for the brand across relevant channels – delivering on brand and on trend content, ensuring quality responses (with escalation as appropriate), proactive outreach, and regular reporting of results fuelling optimisation
- This role will be responsible for community management and the customer care line
- Support and participate in core internal / external sales meetings (ie: Customer Brand days / S&OP meetings)
- Supporting the brand manager in NPD commercialisation and post-evaluations
- Accurate management, phasing, and reporting of local brand budget

Experience you’ll bring:

We're less interested in ticking every box and more interested in finding someone who is excited to learn, grow and make things happen!
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification.
- First experience in brand marketing, shopper marketing, account management, or a related commercial function.
- Experience developing and executing consumer-focused marketing campaigns.
- Strong understanding of digital and social media marketing.
- Ability to manage multiple projects and stakeholders simultaneously.
- Analytical mindset with experience interpreting performance data and translating insights into action.

Preferred Experience
- Project management experience.
- Experience in conversion marketing and shopper activation strategies.

Behaviours You'll Need
- Excellent collaboration and relationship-building skills.
- Strong attention to detail and organisational ability.
- Creative thinker who enjoys turning insight into action.
- Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment.
- Proactive, resourceful, and accountable.
- Results-oriented with a continuous improvement mindset.

Get to know us:
We are the people behind method + Ecover. We’ve always done things differently – we’re fearless thinkers, mad scientists and adventurous designers who believe that making soap leads to brave ideas, bold inventions and beautiful bubbles. We started small but we have big plans to make the world a cleaner, greener, more colourful place. We invite everyone to join us as we pioneer a future where doing business is doing good for all.

Let’s get one thing straight – you’re not coming here to just sell soap, or cleaning products. You’re joining us to move the hearts, souls and minds of others all over the world that see the world differently. We think about cleaning as an act of creative expression, a gesture of rebellion, and, yes, an escape from the normal. We take cleaning seriously – but not ourselves.
Alongside our friends Mrs. Meyer’s clean day and babyganics in the US, we are collectively known as Lifestyle Brands and are part of the SC Johnson family.

Application:
Submit your application today here .
Have you made it this far? If you’re still reading, we think there’s a strong chance you might be our kind of person. Here’s the thing, though — research suggests that 60% of women and underrepresented folks might have already talked themselves out of applying. Even if you don’t check every box above, we want to encourage you to introduce yourself. We believe a diversity of perspectives and experiences makes a team stronger — and the stronger our team, the closer we are to delivering our ambition of a clean world revolution!

It’s a big, beautiful, colourful world out there and we should celebrate that. That’s why we’re working hard to be a fully diverse and inclusive place to work. Every day we strive to create an atmosphere where everyone feels valued, listened to, supported and where we can do our best work. Sure, there’s always more that can be done. But together with our team, partners, customers and community, we can make everyone welcome.
We advertise all our roles on Evenbreak, the specialist job board for disabled candidates. If you have a disability or a long-term health condition and would like support in applying for any of our vacancies, please visit their Career Hive – careers support for disabled candidates delivered by careers professionals with lived experience of disability. Find out more at  https://hive.evenbreak.co.uk .

We are happy to adjust our hiring process to ensure we are accessible to everyone – please let us know what we can do to support you!

Inclusion & Diversity

We believe that being a team of diverse people with different ideas, views and cultures will help us and our business thrive. We are committed to ensuring everyone who works at the LSB feels that they have a real sense of belonging and that they can show up as who they are, be valued, listened to and supported to do their best possible work.

Sure, there’s always more that can be done. But together with our team, partners, customers and community, we can make everyone welcome.

jobs.title: Associate Manager, Consumer Insights & Business Analytics - Walmart
jobs.description:
Lifestyle Brands (the LSB) is a growing house of like-minded brands under the SC Johnson umbrella including Method®, Mrs. Meyer’s Clean Day®,   Babyganics ® and   Ecover ®. Headquartered in San Francisco with additional operations in Chicago and throughout Europe, the LSB is home to 650 employees. Together we act as a force for bold, transformative growth with a focus on delivering positive impact for people and the planet. If you’re into pioneering the future and doing good while doing business, come join us.

The LSB is part of SC Johnson, a family-owned company and leading manufacturer of household cleaning, home storage, air care, pest control and shoe care products, as well as professional products. Originally founded in 1886 and headquartered in Wisconsin, U.S.A., SC Johnson and the Lifestyle Brands division are at work for a better world.

As a Category Leadership Manager, you'll play a critical role in driving growth for Lifestyle Brands, our customers, and the categories in which we compete. Leveraging deep shopper, category, and market insights, you'll uncover opportunities that influence key decisions around assortment, pricing, promotion, merchandising, and shelf strategy.
You'll serve as the lead category thought partner, collaborating cross-functionally to transform data into actionable business recommendations. Beyond supporting customer strategies, you'll bring valuable marketplace learnings back to the organization, helping shape broader commercial decisions and fueling growth across our business. If you're passionate about connecting insights to action and influencing strategy at every level, this is the role for you

ABOUT THE ROLE
- To be the recognized expert in our categories and brands at Walmart.  This role will:
- Provide fact and insight- based solutions that drive growth for category, customer, and the LSB.
- Utilize shopper insight, opportunity identification and full understanding of products, assortment, pricing, placement, shelving, promotion, and merchandising to inform our strategy with assigned customers.
- Lead as primary insight provider for our categories at the customer that lead to marketplace actions. In this role, you will work closely with internal (SCJ Sales, Brand, Customer Marketing) and external partners.
- Provide insights and perspective from customer activities back to the broader organization so that transferable learnings can be leveraged with other customers

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
- Create and plan category leadership solutions that deliver profitable sales growth for the LSB in the mass and club channels. These solutions should include shopper and category insights across products/ assortment (everyday/ new products/ promoted/ seasonal), placement and everyday shelving and merchandising, pricing (everyday, seasonal, and promotional), promotions and seasonal merchandising
- Leverage LSB Category & Shopper Leadership toolbox such as Nielsen RMS & Panel Data, Customer-specific POS & Panel, and other internal/external tools
- SCINTILLA Wal*Mart and Madrid (Sam’s Club) will be of particular focus
- Partner with Sales and cross-functional teams to develop & deliver compelling insights presentations, business reviews, and growth strategies that advance business outcomes at Walmart and Sam’s Club.
- Where appropriate, manage and deliver against the responsibilities of the Category Captaincy/Advisory process in partnership with the customer
- Identify specific research opportunities (shopper, consumer, etc.) to bring new learning to category leadership solutions
- Assist with HQ lead research projects when appropriate, to provide context that will improve the applicability of results in the mass channel.
- Leverage insights and resources through the utilization of a broad range of data sources, market research findings, tools, analyses, and technology to continually bring new shopper ideas to customer and company; incorporate in all category solutions for assigned major customer(s)
- Create / Maintain any customer specific topline reporting / KPI tracking (reporting that is supplemental to HQ generated reporting)
- Be a voice for Walmart in team strategy creation.

REQUIRED EXPERIENCE YOU’LL BRING
- Bachelors degree and 5+ years (or Masters degree and 3+ years) in category management / analytics at a major syndicated data provider or established consumer packaged goods company
- 1+ years experience with SCINTILLA Luminate (Walmart)
- Qualified candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States

PREFERRED EXPERIENCES AND SKILLS
- Strong analytical skills. Solid experience in analyzing syndicated reports or using trade management tools (IRI, NielsenIQ)
- Stamina, character, sense of humor, detail-oriented tactician with proactive approach and work ethic appropriate for a fast-paced, team-oriented, growth company
- Ability to manage multiple priorities and work within tight timeframes and deadlines
- Ability to independently assess data, integrate into selling stories and leverage it to grow our business
- High degree of curiosity on consumer/retail behaviors + insights
- Excellent presentation skills and a colorful storyteller
- Team player eager to support others & build group culture
- Experience in partnering with / presenting to customers
- Towering technical skills, especially in Excel + Powerpoint
- Ability to communicate with data and information in a clear and concise (+fun) fashion
- Proficient with syndicated data (IRI/Nielsen) and panel tools

JOB REQUIREMENTS
- Full Time – regular business hours, Monday – Friday
- Home-office (remote) position based in  Bentonville, AR.
- This role is not offering relocation assistance
- Travel ~15% to be dictated by customer team need

BENEFITS AND PERKS
- Our values are at the heart of everything we do.  Here are a few of the ways we  Care like a Mother  for every person against dirty:
- Rockstar health insurance benefits package
- Jollydays: competitive vacation bundle
- Generous retirement match + pre-tax savings options
- 3 Care Days (a.k.a. Volunteer Time-Off) a year, to be a force for good
- Global Ping Pong Tournament + Bubble Bash..(Its kinda like the Prom you never went to…or regret..) either way, let's dance

Other duties, responsibilities and activities may change or be assigned
at any time with or without notice as assigned by the Manager. The job description
does not constitute a contract of employment and the position remains at-will

Inclusion & Diversity

We believe that being a team of diverse people with different ideas, views and cultures will help us and our business thrive. We are committed to ensuring everyone who works at the LSB feels that they have a real sense of belonging and that they can show up as who they are, be valued, listened to and supported to do their best possible work.

Sure, there’s always more that can be done. But together with our team, partners, customers and community, we can make everyone welcome.

Better Together
At SC Johnson, we believe people achieve their best when they collaborate and work together in person. We value connection to strengthen teamwork, accelerate problem solving, and drive innovation.

Equal Opportunity Employer
The policy of the Company is to ensure equal opportunity for all qualified applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, gender, marital status, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, age, gender identity, gender expression, disability, citizenship, pregnancy, veteran status, membership in any active or reserve component of the U.S. or state military forces, genetic history or information or any other category protected by law.

Accommodation Requests
If you are an individual with a disability and you need an accommodation or other assistance during the application process, please call our Human Resources department at 262-260-3343 or email your request to SCJHR@scj.com . All qualified applicants are encouraged to apply. Download the EEO Know Your Rights poster  for more information.

Commercial Finance Manager - UK Hub

Internal title: Associate Manager, Financial Planning and Analysis
Location: Frimley
Contract type: Full time
People Leader: Head of Finance P&A
Function: FP&A Manager

Please note this role is not eligible for relocation.
Remote work is available once per week for eligible employees.

If you are looking for a new challenge in Finance and you are interested in being the main Finance Business Partner for Sales and Marketing, we are waiting for you!

What’s in it for you?
- Competitive pay & benefits
- Flexible working hours + Summer hours
- ‘Build your own’ learning programme
- Free breakfast & snacks
- 25 days annual holiday
- Pension, Life cover & Health Insurance
- Volunteering days
- Season ticket loan
- Wellness days

Overview:
We’re looking for a numbers-guru, someone passionate about business partnering and providing financial insights. As we see the world differently and do things differently, we are looking for someone to challenge the status quo and provide thought leadership to improve our decision making.
You will be the right-hand person to the UK Hub Leader and Head of FP&A, a sparring partner to drive the business forward to achieve the seemingly impossible!

Responsibilities:
- Bring your personality to our LSB team. Live and breathe the values of LSB and care for your colleagues.
- Work in partnership with the UK leadership team, establishing strong relationships with and the wider UK sales teams and Brand teams.
- Provide visibility to regional UK team via weekly, and monthly reporting, and pioneer the future by creating tools to enhance financial clarity and decision-making that is accurate, clear, and actionable.
- Lead all aspects of the monthly and quarterly financial forecast process as well as annual budgeting for the regional hub, determining drivers of risk and opportunity versus the operating plan.
- Partner closely within the S&OP cycle to ensure financial alignment, challenge assumptions, and support effective decision‑making.
- Deliver sound, strategic, and actionable course correcting recommendations to the respective leadership teams. Ensure spending is in line with budget or revised forecast expectations
- For all key decisions within the region (product/customer portfolio, promotion/pricing, cost savings actions, investments), provide credible financial modelling and influence the business with continuous guidance and advice on methods to improve, or maximize the financial opportunity of those considerations.
- Lead the UK region month end P&L close, ensuring accuracy of the UK region monthly P&L.
- Work closely with the sales and brand team to accurately capture all trade spend and brand spend activities ensuring no financially material surprises. Including ownership of the UK trade spend balance sheet reconciliations to allow for review of trade spend positions aligned with
- Review trade spends and brand activities ensuring that we are getting adequate ROI for the spend (recommendation our how best the region should be spending the money)
- Relentlessly pursue opportunities to enhance processes, improve forecast accuracy, assess risks, and drive urgency across the organization to maximize Net Sales, Delivered Profit Margin, and Operating Profit.
- Partner with wider LSB finance team in assessing other sales and general admin costs for the UK, the monthly close results and sharing actuals and implications to the broader organization.
- Partner with the Head of FP&A to maintain robust internal controls across the regional hub and ensure the appropriate retention of supporting documentation required for internal and external audits of Trade Spend and Pricing Management.
- Make objective recommendations that serve the best interests of the region and company as a whole.

Experience you’ll bring:
- Qualified Accountant with min. 5 years PQE with a strong academic record and substantial finance experience gained in a variety of environments
- Experience in commercial finance/FP&A a must, exposure to FMCG is a plus!
- Previous ownership of financial forecasting, and other critical financial process and analysis
- Proven ability to communicate complex financial information concisely and accurately to a broad audience
- Experience working with and influencing cross functional teams
- Embeds financial knowledge and understanding with business partners to ensure focus on supporting the right initiatives and business decisions
- Ability to build powerful influencing relationships at all levels while also creating the energy and momentum for required change
- System-savvy - an Excel whiz, with SAP and Anaplan experience a major plus

Behaviors you’ll need:
- Be relentless in pursuit of partnering, a born problem solver challenging the business and regional director
- Have strong commercial and financial acumen and will understand which levers of the P&L to drive performance
- Have a desire to get stuck in to make processes simpler and easier,
- Have a positive attitude, be resilient and confident, with an ability to influence the leadership team
- Will possess the ability to navigate through complexity and prioritize
- Be great at building relationships and establishing great ways of working
- Show proactivity to drive the Hub/business agenda forward
- Have an eye for detail but also have the ability to stand back and see the bigger picture
